class.name: OcgXscontrolTransferwriter
class.brief_description: TransferWriter gives help to control transfer to write a file after having converted data from Cascade/Imagine
class.description: ! TransferWriter gives help to control transfer to write a file ! after having converted data from Cascade/Imagine ! ! It works with a Controller (which itself can work with an ! Actor to Write) and a FinderProcess. It records results and ! checks

method.name: XSControl_TransferWriter
method.description: Creates a TransferWriter, empty, ready to run with an empty FinderProcess (but no controller, etc)

method.name: SetFinderProcess
method.description: Sets a new FinderProcess and forgets the former one

method.name: SetController
method.description: Sets a new Controller, also sets a new FinderProcess

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears recorded data according a mode 0 clears FinderProcess (results, checks) -1 create a new FinderProcess

method.name: TransferMode
method.description: Returns the current Transfer Mode (an Integer) It will be interpreted by the Controller to run Transfers This call form could be later replaced by more specific ones (parameters suited for each norm / transfer case)

method.name: PrintStats
method.description: Prints statistics on current Trace File, according what,mode See PrintStatsProcess for details

method.name: RecognizeTransient
method.description: Tells if a transient object (from an application) is a valid candidate for a transfer to a model Asks the Controller (RecognizeWriteTransient) If <obj> is a HShape, calls RecognizeShape

method.name: TransferWriteTransient
method.description: Transfers a Transient object (from an application) to a model of current norm, according to the last call to SetTransferMode Works by calling the Controller Returns status : =0 if OK, >0 if error during transfer, <0 if transfer badly initialised

method.name: RecognizeShape
method.description: Tells if a Shape is valid for a transfer to a model Asks the Controller (RecognizeWriteShape)

method.name: TransferWriteShape
method.description: Transfers a Shape from CasCade to a model of current norm, according to the last call to SetTransferMode Works by calling the Controller Returns status : =0 if OK, >0 if error during transfer, <0 if transfer badly initialised

method.name: CheckList
method.description: Returns the check-list of last transfer (write), i.e. the check-list currently recorded in the FinderProcess

method.name: ResultCheckList
method.description: Returns the check-list of last transfer (write), but tries to bind to each check, the resulting entity in the model instead of keeping the original Mapper, whenever known
